title: Watch the turning point with devotion
caption:
Some hearts cannot do dry techniques. This one is for them.

Technique 8 of 112. The body is a temple. When you breathe, it is the divine within you breathing. Rest at the two turnings of the breath with love, and know the knower.

Save this and share it with someone devotional.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.
